description: This file defines the GithubResourceOwner class, which implements the ResourceOwnerInterface. It provides methods to access GitHub user data from OAuth2 responses, such as id, email, name, nickname, and URL, and allows setting the domain. It uses traits for array access helper functions.

classes.name: GithubResourceOwner
classes.description: Represents a GitHub resource owner with methods to access user info like id, email, name, etc., based on OAuth2 response data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the resource owner with an optional response array.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the resource owner's ID from the response data.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the resource owner's email from the response data.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the resource owner's name from the response data.

methods.name: getNickname
methods.description: Returns the resource owner's nickname (login) from the response data.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for the resource owner, composed of domain and login if available.

methods.name: setDomain
methods.description: Sets the domain field for the resource owner.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the raw response array representing all owner details.
